latest_update: Public caveat refreshed after the SGA5 live source-audit workpass advanced to p186. Repair032 is public as a bundled audit-support artifact on record 20822648. It is not a completed or certified SGA5 edition. The controlling manual certification log treats agents/workflows as finders rather than certifiers and now records pp.1-186 as page-local hand-certification evidence: pp.1-72 close Expose I; pp.73-137 close Expose III; Expose III B Part I (sections 1-4, pp.140-161) is marked complete in the page-local ledger; Expose III B Part II section 5 is locally closed through p182, and section 6 has started with pp.183-186 checked locally. The current ledger reports 15 TeX fixes plus one cosmetic p172 cleanup, 31 source typos found, D001-D101 covered in the running diagram ledger, and a 307-page / zero-fatal-error compile; p186 defines the non-commutative local trace (6.5.3) and records D101, the fixed-point cartesian square, as perfect. The p171 and p175 fixes show why compile success and agent passes are not certification: mathematically wrong diagram/display tensor bases can compile cleanly. The p69 scope note clarifies that the source scan is the full 484-page LNM 589, but the local TeX is a curated 10-expose selection (I, III, IIIB, V, VI, VII, VIII, X, XII, XV); current pp.1-186 certification is opening-range evidence, not global SGA5 certification. Continued page-by-page hand certification from p187 onward, global referenced-label/notation audit, independent validation, optional low-value prose-fidelity review where desired, and English synchronization remain open; not complete, not critical, and not globally source-faithful.
